event_alignment: maximum deceleration per contiguous candidate run
reorientation: integral of absolute smoothed yaw >=30 degrees in [-0.5,0.5] s
heat_context: all measured command samples >0.05 V within [-0.5,0.5] s; all <=0.05 V = no heat; mixed = transition; barrier control episodes separate
context_limitation: No heat means no current command in the core window; recent heat exposure is not excluded. Core context can change outside +/-0.5 s, as shown by command traces. Events are not behavior-matched.
fluorescence: ROI 1 raw dF/F; no amplitude exclusions or event baseline subtraction in trace plots
scatter_response: mean dF/F 0:1 s minus mean -2:-1 s
xy: protocol logged positions and measured geometry time alignment; never overlay geometry on independently reconstructed ficpath coordinates
background: normalized programmed profile, not measured temperature; pale red = heat, gray = virtual control profile
color_display: trajectory limits: 1st-99th recording percentiles; event heatmap: 2nd-98th event-window percentiles; display clipping does not exclude samples
pooling: none across recordings; no hypothesis tests
quality_checks: geometry aligned by measured tracking timestamps
stripe reconstruction agrees with logged zone membership >98%
event windows require finite fluorescence, behavior, command, position and behaviorVolumeValid when available
